== Biography ==

Mrs. Rabbit is the mother of four rabbits—Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter—who live in a sand-bank beneath the root of a very large fir-tree. She directs her children not to enter Mr. McGregor's garden, warning them that their father had an accident there and was put in a pie by Mrs. McGregor. When Mrs. Rabbit sets out to the baker's, carrying her basket and umbrella, she reminds them not to get into mischief and returns with provisions: a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
